items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And it starts off with me doing my best kind of Barney Kessel licks.

ctx.x: Do you get checks in the mail?

Mostly it’s direct deposit these days. But you know what’s really been an amazing thing is when I first started doing sessions in London, it was — I forget what it was — it was like maybe 17 pounds or something for a 3 hour session. And then I joined Wings and it’s a whole different experience. And what got me into Wings was my versatility also. I mean that’s always been kind of a calling card for me is the fact that I can play multiple styles, which that’s the way that Paul operates as an artist, Paul McCartney…
